import statistics
import time
import tracemalloc

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from orders.app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def _call(method, url, body):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    response = client.request(method, url, content=body or None, headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
    return response, (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000

import time
from statistics import median, quantiles

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from orders.app import app


def test_quote_latency_stays_within_baseline_budget():
    payload = {"items": [], "tier": "standard"}

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        warmup = client.post("/quote", json=payload)
        assert (
            warmup.status_code == 200
        ), f"Warmup request to /quote should succeed, got HTTP {warmup.status_code}"

        timings_ms = []
        statuses = []
        for _ in range(20):
            start = time.perf_counter()
            response = client.post("/quote", json=payload)
            elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
            timings_ms.append(elapsed_ms)
            statuses.append(response.status_code)

        assert all(
            status == 200 for status in statuses
        ), f"/quote should return HTTP 200 on healthy requests, got {statuses}"

    p50_ms = median(timings_ms)
    p95_ms = quantiles(timings_ms, n=100, method="inclusive")[94]

    assert (
        p50_ms <= 10.8
    ), f"/quote median latency {p50_ms:.2f} ms exceeds the healthy budget of 10.8 ms"
    assert (
        p95_ms <= 21.99
    ), f"/quote p95 latency {p95_ms:.2f} ms exceeds the healthy budget of 21.99 ms"
